The Ni 45-x(FeCoCr)40(AlTi)15Hfx (x = 0, 0.2 at.%) alloys were prepared by arc melting process in a high-purity argon atmosphere. The purity of all elements is higher than 99.95% (wt, %). The alloys were melted for four times to obtain homogeneous element distribution.

The Ni 45-x(FeCoCr)40(AlTi)15Hfx (x = 0, 0.2 at.%) alloys were prepared by arc melting process in a high-purity argon atmosphere. The purity of all elements is higher than 99.95% (wt, %). The alloys were melted for four times to obtain homogeneous element distribution.

Combined with the lattice constant (0.35872 nm) of particles measured from the XRD result, particles can be identi ﬁed as (Ni,Co)3(Al,Ti) type γ′ phase.
Nanoparticles with a volume fraction of 54% and an average diameter of 90 nm are observed in inter-dendritic region, as shown in Fig. 1(c).
α-Ni 2AlTi phase (less than 2%) with ordered BCC structure is also found in inter-dendritic regions.
